Name: Gold Stardrop Hero Trophy
Author: Wumbuzz
Description:
You went out of your way to complete the Community Center, so flaunt this Stardrop Hero Statue made from solid gold!

This mod is purely cosmetical and replaces the vanilla "Stardew Hero Statue" with a golden Stardrop version.

Downloads.Description: Simply unpack in your mods folder to replace the trophy.
